lines.text: Many learners say: I am 170 centimeters height.
Tall! My brother is 180 centimeters tall.

native.tip: Kita bilang “tinggi saya 170 cm”, tapi kalau mulai dengan I am, akhiri dengan tall: I am 170 centimeters tall.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am 170 centimeters height.” 😅 Setelah I am dan angka, pakai tall: “I am 170 centimeters tall.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “tall”. Tulis satu kalimat tentang tinggi badanmu: “I am ... centimeters tall.” Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “tinggi saya 170 cm”, but after I am, end with tall: I am 170 centimeters tall.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am 170 centimeters height.” 😅 After I am and a number, use tall: “I am 170 centimeters tall.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
